_comment: Opening melee of a small 10-vs-10 cavalry clash resolves per soldier, not as a regiment-formula wipe. Player cavalry at (500,400) facing down; enemy cavalry at (500,700) facing up; 300 wu between centres so the 120-wu-deep boxes do not overlap at spawn. Team 0 holds until an explicit attack (click, then right-click the enemy). Both sides close, lock, and trade blows: neither roster vanishes in one tick at regiment-circle range (~66 wu), and once in contact the grind actually wounds. drill is set so Battle._check_victory cannot pause the sim if one side later does break -- there IS real combat here. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
